objective_value: <float> Total number of hyperplanes used to cover all points.

hyperplanes.w: <list[float], length d> Unit-norm normal vector defining the orientation of this hyperplane.
hyperplanes.w0: <float> Scalar offset defining the position of this hyperplane.
hyperplanes.assigned_points: <list[int]> Indices of points assigned to this hyperplane.

point_assignments: <list[list[int]], length n> For each point, the list of hyperplane indices (into the hyperplanes array) to which it is assigned.
